title: Inference Native scope retirement
$comment: Migration 0280 adds an immutable backend scope-retirement intent. The Native transaction closes one admission scope before a separate bounded HTTP exchange, then reconciles only that scope after a reply from the exact bound backend incarnation proves retired with zero tracked requests.

policy.ready: database-local routing authority secret is available

actions.name: prepare
actions.semantics: Validates the current realm, scope capability, committed transport and bound epoch/incarnation. It serializes against begin_attempt using the scope row lock, closes admission, and persists a replayable immutable intent before HTTP is sent. Same-ID replay returns that intent; another ID for the same scope conflicts.

actions.name: status
actions.semantics: Read-only; requires the original realm-bound scope capability and never returns endpoint credentials.

actions.name: finish
actions.semantics: Requires the exact pinned retirement identity and a still-current transport/epoch/incarnation. Draining remains unresolved. Only retired with active_requests=0 reconciles active or uncertain attempts in this scope; response rows and all other scopes remain unchanged.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.scope_retirements
private_tables.semantics: Unique scope identity makes retirement ID immutable for that scope. The full transport identity hash and config revision pin Registry state without storing another bearer copy; guarded prepare/finish calls derive endpoint credentials from the current Registry row only in private context. Credentials never enter command receipts or public retirement views.

aap_inference_routing_v1.scopes.admissio.semantics: High-water for every exact admission JWT exp. Existing 0279 scopes are conservatively fenced until migration time plus 300 seconds because their prior exact expiries were not stored; new scopes start at epoch and the signer records each actual exp atomically.

guards: Open retirements count as unresolved work for Registry and management admission.
Management control preparation and epoch/incarnation changes are fenced while a retirement is open.

Lock order is Registry SHARE, registry_state, scope, retirement; begin_attempt uses the same scope serialization plus compatible Registry SHARE. Contended Native locks return management_busy without HTTP in the transaction.
A timeout, lost reply, replacement incarnation, or zero count from a different incarnation never completes retirement or reconciles attempts.
Downgrade refuses open retirements and restores the 0279 admission signer before dropping the high-water column.
